## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Identify any change to package scope,
vendor trust, permissions, report coverage, or pass/review/incomplete decisions.

## Validation

Record the relevant tests and results. For scanner or adapter changes, include
the real-engine smoke run and resolved vendor versions when available.

## Release impact

Note consumer pin updates, compatibility changes, or documentation changes.
Keep examples synthetic and do not attach private skill contents or raw scanner logs.
